# UniFFI runtime distribution

These archives are generated third-party dependencies, not handwritten copies
of app bindings. `source-lock.json` records their exact upstream source, patches,
and build tools. `receipt.json` records the resulting source tree and artifact
digests. See `applications/tools/ubrn-vendor/README.md` for rebuilding, checking,
and replacing them with an upstream release.

The upstream implementation is licensed under MPL-2.0. Its original license
notice and source record are preserved in each npm archive; the patch sources
are retained beside this file. The source URL in the record identifies the
unmodified source to which those patches apply.
